prompt: In a StackOne connector YAML I'm building a SOAP request body. How do I include an XML element only when the action's input for it is set, and leave it out otherwise?
skill_note: Custom connector YAML is cli territory.

fetch.name: fetches-expression-or-soap-docs
fetch.note: The expression language reference or the soap_request step function.

reply.name: uses-present
reply.note: The function that tests whether an input is set.

reference: The expression language has a present() function for testing whether an input is set.
A ternary in an interpolated expression can return the element when present and null when not, for example {{present(inputs.x) ? ... : null}}, and a null value drops the element.
Fields also accept a condition using present(), for example condition: '{{present(inputs.filter)}}'.
